record.issue_text: [P2] handleCancelBooking recurring-deletion loop nested inside bookingCalendarReference loop, multiplying duplicate delete calls per reference per credential

adjudication.rationale: In `handleCancelBooking.ts`, `bookingCalendarReference` was changed from a single `.find(...)` result to an array via `.filter(...)`, and the deletion logic is now wrapped in `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference) { ... }`. Inside that outer loop, the recurring-event branch builds `promises` by iterating over *all* calendar credentials (`bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...endsWith("_calendar"))`) and then iterates `updatedBookings` to delete events, pushing each delete into `apiDeletes`. Because this whole recurring deletion block is nested inside the per-reference loop, if there are multiple calendar references (which is now plausible given the multi-destination calendar refactor), the same set of deletes will be executed once per reference, multiplying duplicate delete calls.
